A '''cell block''' in the [[Minimum Security Section]] of [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], was one of the cell blocks that the Republic regained control of following the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|initial attack]] on the world.
